title: דְַד
content: [Str1414] † [דְַד] vb. hew down (TargumJ; Syr. (rare); BH cut);—Pe. Imv. mpl. גֹּ֫דּוּ אִילָנָא (K§ 46, Beisp, a) Dn 4:11, 4:20.

title: דָּא
content: [Str1668,2090,2088] † דָּא demonstr. pr. f. this (= BH זֹה:Zinj. Têma, Cappad. Eg. Aram. זא, Nab. דא, Palm. דה (Lzb264: Eph. i. 323 Cooke26), Targum דא: v. further sub BH זֶה. The corresp. masc. is דְּנָה);—this, Dn 4:27 הֲלָא דָיא בַּבֶל רַבְּתָא, 5:6 דָּא לְדָא נָֽקְשָׁן one striking against another, similarly 7:3 (cf. זֶה 1 b), v8 בְקַרְנָא־דָא.

title: דֹּב
content: [Str1677–78] † דֹּב n. [m.] bear (so Targum BH √ דבב; Syr. ܕܒܐ);—abs. ´ד: Dn 7:5.

title: דְּבַח
content:
[Str1684,2076] † [דְּבַח] vb. sacrifice (BH זָבַח);—Pe. Pt. act. pl. דָּֽבְחִין Ezr 6:3, c. acc. דִּבְחִין, v. foll.

[Str1685] † [דִּבַח] n. [m.] sacrifice;—pl. abs. דִּבְחִין Ezr 6:3.

[Str4056] † [מַדְבַּח] n. [m.] altar;—emph. מַדְבְּחָא Ezr 7:17.

title: דְּבֵק
content:
[Str1692–93] † [דְּבֵק] vb. cling (BH);—Pe. Pt. pl. דָּֽבְקִין דְּנָה עִם־דְּנָה Dn 2:43.

[Str1700–01] † [דִּבְרָה] n. f. cause, reason (BH id., √ דבר, cf. על דבר Eg. Aram. S-CPap. B 5.6.8.16);—cstr. in adv. phr. עַל־דִּבְרַת דִּי Dn 2:30 for the cause (to the intent) that, 4:14 (rd. עַל for עַד K§ ll, 2 Bev).

title: דּוּר
content: [Str1752–53] † [דּוּר] vb. dwell (v. BH);—Pe. Impf. 3 fs. of beasts תְּדוּר Dn 4:18; 3 mpl. birds יְדֻרוּן v:9 (Qr f. יְדוּרָן, f. subj., חִפֲּרֵי, follows, cf. v:18 and K§ 98, 2 c, Anm. 3); Pt. pl. of men, דָּאדִין Kt 2:38, 3:31, 6:26 (Qr דָּֽיְרִין); as subst., cstr. דָּארֵי Kt 4:32, 4:32 (Qr דָּֽיְרֵי) as subst., cstr. דָּארֵי Kt 4:32, 4:32 (Qr דָּֽיְרֵי dwellers.

title: דָּר
content:
[Str1755,1859] דָּר n.[m.] generation (BH דּוֺר);—abs. in phr. עִם־דָּר וְדָו Dn 3:33, 4:31 (is) with generation and generation, i.e. endures gen. after gen.

[Str4070] † [מְדוֺר] n.[m.] dwelling place;—sf. מְדֹרָךְ Dn 4:22, 4:29, מְדוֺרֵהּ 5:21.

[Str4070] † [מְדָר] n. m. id.;—sf. מָדְֽרָהוֺן Dn 2:11.

[Str8411,1752] † תְּדִירָא n. f. continuance (Targum id.; v. BH דּוּר);—abs. in phr. ´בִּת: continually Dn 6:17, 6:21.

[Str1757] † דּוּרָא n. pr. loc. near Bab., only ´בִּקְעַת ד: Dn 3:1, LXX. τοῦ περιβόλου (Syro-Hex. περίβολον), Θ Δεειρα; Dûru is name of several places in Babylonia DlPar. 216; Baer Dn. p. x, cf. AndrM 58*; HoffmPers. Märtyrer 164 f.; name of small river and mounds OppExpêd. i. 238 f. (v. Dr); improb. expl. as = رور zôr, depression (name actually used of lower Euphr. and Tigris valleys) by WetzstDe Jes3 701 f.; Bab. dûru = wall.

title: דּוּשׁ
content: [Str1759] † [דּוּשׁ] vb. tread down (BH);—Pe. Impf. 3 fs. (sf. of earth) חְדֻשִׁנַּהּ Dn 7:23, subj. beast.

title: דַּחֲוָה
content: [Str1761,1760] ‡† [דַּחֲוָה] n. f. dub.;—pl. abs. דַּחֲוָן Dn 6:19, Vrss conject.; AV RV instr. of music (so AE, assuming meaning str1 Ke [strings] for דְּחָא [BH דָּחָה] thrust; Saad RVm dancing-girls; Bertholdt al. concubines (fr. sens. obsc. of Ar. دَحَي, but then read prob. לְחֵנָן (5:2, 5:3, 5:23) Marti Prince Dr.

title: דְּחַל
content: [Str1763,2119] † [דְּחַל] vb. fear (so Targum Syr.; BH II. [זָחַל];—Pe. Pt. act. pl. דָּֽחְלִין Dn 5:19, c. מִן־קֳדָם of king, 6:27, id. of God; pass. דְּחִיל terrible 2:31, f. דְּחִילָה 7:7, 7:19. Pa. Impf. 3 ms. sf. וִידֵחֲלִנַּנִי 4:2 the dream made me afraid.

title: דִּי
content: [Str1768,2088,834] דִּי part of relation, who, which, that, used also as mark of gen. and conj. that, because (Aram. of Nineveh, Bab. Zinj. Nerab, Cilicia, Têma, Egypt, זִי (Lzb267. 446 RES361 S-CPap. A 2 +); Nab. Palm. די; Targum דְּ (exc. in cpds., as דִּילִי mine, דִּילֵיהּ his); Sam. ࠃ; Syr. ܕ; Eth. ዝ፡ za: of same origin as Ar. دُو possessor of [cf. sub BH זֶה]. Properly a demonstr. that [cf. זֶה; in Eth. ze is ‘this’, za ‘which’]; but this being referred by usage to something preceding becomes equiv. to the relative who, which, used, however, more widely than Heb. אֲשֶׁר);—1. as rel. who, which (construed like אֲשֶׁר): a. Je 10:11, Dn 2:11 דִּי מְדָֽרְהוֺן whose dwelling, v:24 דִּי מַנִּי מַלְבָּא whom the king had appointed, v:26 ´דִּי שְׁמֵהּ בּ: whose name was B., 4:5, 5:12, 5:23, etc.; = that which 2:23; = him that Ezr 7:25; 6:15, Dn 7:17 דִּת אִנוּן אַרְבַּע which are four (v. אִנּוּן). Sq. pron. of 2 ps. (cf. אֲשֶׁר 3), Dn 2:37 thou, O king ..., יְהַב לָח…דִּי: to whom... hath given, 4:19, 4:6 as to whom I know, etc. (cf. אֲשֶׁר 4 d end). Sq. תַּמָּה = where Ezr 6:1, so דִּי alone 6:3, Dn 2:38; of time, בְּעִדָּנָא דִּי at the time when, etc., 3:5, 3:15. With the pred. an inf. c. לְ, Dn 6:9 כְּתָבָא דִּי לָא לְהַשְׁנָיָה which is not to be changed, Ezr 6:8; a place- or other determination, Dn 3:20 valiant men בְחֵילֵהּ that were in his army, 5:2 הֵיכְלָא דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֵב, 7:20, Ezr 4:24, 5:6, 6:2, 6:6; cf. Dn 2:25, 5:13, 7:7, Ezr 7:23. דִּי לָא = without, Ezr 6:9, 7:22 (so דְּלָא Targum Gn 15:2, Ex 21:11); cf. Dn 2:34, 2:45. b. מָן דִּי, מָה דִּי (cf. in late Heb. ´מַה־שֶּׁ:, מַה 1 e b) whoever, whatever, so † Dn 3:6, 3:11 יִפֵּל מָֽן־דִּי־לָא whoever does not fall down, 4:14 לְמָן דִּי יִצְבֵּא to whomsoever he willeth, v:22, v:29, 5:21; מָה דִי whatever (or simply what), † Dn 2:28 מָה דִּי לֶהֱוֵא what will be, v:29, v:29, v:45, Ezr 6:8, 7:18.—Cf. K§ 103. 2. as mark of the gen., Dn 2:15 שׁליטא די מלכא prop. the captain, that of the king = the king’s captain (a genuine Aram. idiom: so Targum דְּ, Syr. ܕ constantly), v:19, v:25, v:49 + oft.: the subst. in such cases may be either in the emph. state (determined), as ll. cc. Ezr 4:15, 5:2, etc., or in the abs. state (undetermined), Dn 5:5, 7:4, 7:9, 7:10 נְהַר דִּי נוּר; or it may have a pleon. sf., 2:20 שְׁמֵהּ דִּי אֱלָהָא lit. his name, that of God = God’s name, v:44, 3:8, 3:25, 3:26, 4:23, etc. (so also Targum Syr.). To circumscribe an adj., esp. in specif. of the material: Dn 2:38 thou art רֵאשָׁה דִּי דַהֲבָא the head of gold, v:39, 3:1, 5:7, 5:16, Ezr 5:14, 6:4 +; as predic. Dn 2:32 רֵאשֵׁהּ דִּי־דְהַב טָב his head (was) of fine gold, v:33, 7:19; with a pron. Dn 2:20 wisdom and might דִּי־לֵהּ הִיא are his; cf. 6:27 וּמַלְכוּתֵהּ דִּי־לָא תִתְחַבַּל his kingdom (is one) which shall not be destroyed, 7:14.—Vid. further K§ 81. 3. as conj. (cf. אֲשֶׁר 8): a. that (quod), after vbs. of knowing, Dn 2:8, 2:9, seeing 2:45, 3:27, hearing 5:14, etc.; introducing the subject of a sentence, …דִּי:…יְדִיעַ: 3:18, Ezr 4:13; Dn 2:47 …מִן־קְשֹׁט דִּי: True is it that … (cf. אָמְנָם כִּי Jb 12:2). b. = in that, inasmuch as, whereas: Dn 2:41 and whereas (דִּי) thou sawest, etc. … it shall be a divided kingdom, v:43, 4:20, 4:23; as a connecting link = seeing that, because, for (cf. אֲשֶׁר 8 c) 2:9, 2:20 b, 2:23 b, 2:47 b, 4:15, 6:24 b. c. that (ut), after vbs. of asking Dn 2:16, commanding 3:10, 3:29, expressing a purpose 4:3, 5:15, Ezr 4:15, 6:10 +; דִּי לָא that not (ne) Dn 2:18, 3:28, 6:18 (on דִּי לְמָה lest Ezr 7:23, see מה). d. prefixed to direct narr. (like כִּי 1 b, and sts. אֲשֶׁר 8 a γ, and ὅτι recitativum), Dn 2:25 and said thus unto him דִּי־הַשְׁכַּחַת (that) I have found, etc., 5:7, 6:6, 6:14. 4. with preps. and other prefixes: a. כְּדִי (like Heb. כַּאֲשֶׁר; so Eg. Aram. כזי, Palm. Nab. כדי, Lzb293 SACG1 62, 63 Cooke369 b RES361; Targum כַּד, Syr. ܟܕ); a according as, Dn 2:43; b. so soon as, when, 3:7, 5:20, 6:11, 6:15. b. מִן־דִּי: a. because that, Dn 3:22, Ezr 5:12 (cf. מֵאֲשֶׁר Is 43:4); b. from (the time) that, after (ex quo), Dn 4:23, Ezr 4:23. c. עַד דִּי until, Dn 2:9, 2:34, 4:30, 7:22; = ere that 6:25. d. עַל דִּי Dn 3:19 is not a conj., but means above that which ... e. for עַל דִּבְרַת דִּי and כָּל־קֳבֵל דִּי see [דִּבְרָה] and קֳבֵל.

title: דִּין
content:
[Str1777–78] † [דִּין] vb. judge (BH);—Pe. Pt. pl. דָּאֲנִין Ezr 7:25 Kt (Qr דָּֽנִין), sq. ל Pers.

[Str1780] † דִּין n. m.:Ezr 7:26 judgement;—abs. ´ד: Dn 4:34 = justice (of ways of God); emph. דִּינָה מִתְעֲבֵד מִנֵּהּ Ezr 7:26 judgment be executed upon him; דִּינָא = judges, court Dn 7:10, 7:26 + perhaps v:22 (reading ´וְד: יְהִב [יְתִב וְשָׁלְטָנָא], Ew Bev Kmp Dr); MT however = judgment was given in favour of (v. Dr).

[Str1782] † [דַּיָּן] n m. judge;—pl. דַּתָּנִין Ezr 7:25.

[Str4083,4082] † [מְדִינָה] n. f. (judicial) district, province (K§ 60, 3) d); also BH);—emph. מְדִינְתָּא (M§ 72 c) Ezr 5:8, 6:2; cstr. מְדִינַת Dn 2:48, 2:49, 3:1, 3:12, 3:30, Ezr 7:16; pl. abs. מְדִנָן 4:15, emph. מְדִינָתָא Dn 3:2, 3:3.

[Str1841] דָּנִיֵּאל n. pr. m. Daniel (BH id.);—Dn 2:13, 2:14 + 50 t. Dn.

[Str1784] דִּינָיֵא n. pr. gent. (?) Ezr 4:9 (so most, but HoffmZA ii. 55 Marquart64 AndrM 59* MeyEntst. J. 39 Str46* read דַּיָּנַיָּא judges (as transl. of Pers. dâtabara), while Scheft81 (improb.) cp. OIran. *denya, (the) orthodox, i.e. Persians).

title: דֵּךְ
content:
[Str1791,479] † דֵּךְ demonstr. pr. m. this, f. דָּח; only Ezr; Dn uses דִּכֵּן (Eg. and Cappad. Aram. זך (CISii. 151 RÉS361 B S-CPap. (f. דכא, דכי ib.:F 6, 9), LzbEph. i. 67); Targum דֵּיכֵי, f. דָּח; Ar. دَاكَ; Eth. ዝንኩ፡ From دَاء זֶה, דָּא (f.), with the affix ך (WCG 110), thus lit. = Germ. dieser da. The pl. is אִלֵּח, q.v.);—this (always after its subst.), Ezr 5:16 שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּר דֵח, v:17 בֵּית־אֱלָהָא דֵח, 6:7, 6:8, 6:12; f. 4:13, 4:15, 4:16, 4:16, 4:19, 4:21 all קִרְיְתָא דָח, 5:8. p. 1080

[Str1797,1791] † דִּכֵּן demonstr. pr. comm. this, that; only Dn; Ezr uses דֵח (דֵּח + demonstr. affix. n, WCG 111);—Dn 2:31 ´צַלְמָא ד:, 7:20, 7:21 ´קַרְנָא ד:.

title: דְּבַר
content:
[Str1798,2145] † [דְּבַר] n. m. ram (Targum דִּכְרָא, Syr. ܕܟܪܐ id., also (and primarily) male, v. BH זָכָר);—pl. דִּכְּ רִין for sacrifice Ezr 6:9, 6:17, 7:17.

[Str1799,2146] † [דִּכְרוֺן] n. [m.] memorandum, record (BH זִכָּרוֺן, √ זָכַר; cf. Nab. Palm. ן(ו)דבר Lzb268 SAC40 Cooke234 +);—emph. דִּכְרוֺנָה Ezr 6:2.

† [דָּכְרָן] n. [m.] id.;—pl. emph. סְפַר דָּכְרָנַיָּא Ezr 4:15, 4:15.

title: דְּלַק
content: [Str1814–15] † [דְּלַק] vb. burn (BH);—Pe. Pt. act. דָּלִָק (K§ 29:1) Dn 7:9 burning fire.

title: דְּמָה
content: [Str1819,1821] † [דְּמָה] vb. be like (BH I. דָּמָה);—Pe. Pt. act. דָּמֵה Dn 3:25 (ל Pers.); f. דָּֽמְיָה 7:5 (לְדֹב).

title: דְּנָה
content: [Str1836,459] דְּנָה:57 demonstr. pr. comm. this (Zinj. זן, זנה; Eg. Aram. זנה (S-C: Pap. B 17 +); זנך (ib.:C 6, D 8); Nab. Palm. דנה (Lzb264 Cooke26); Targum דֵּין (e.g. 1 S 10:27) and (with הָ, i.e. הָא, ܗܐ ecce) הָדֵתן; Aram. of Têma הא זא (Cooke195. 198); Syr. ܗܢܐ (contr. for הָֽדְנָא); Mand. האזין; Sab. دن (HomChrest. 13); Eth. ዝንቱ፡ all from [דֶּה,] זה, + demonstr. n. (WCG 108 f.); fem. BAram. דָּא, Targum דָּא, הָדה, Syr. ܗܕܝܢ, Mand. האזא, Eth. ዝኣቲ፡ without the n; the pl. is אִלֵּין, q. v.);—this: a. Dn 2:18 רָזָא דְנָה this secret, v:28, v:29, v:30 +, Ezr 4:11, 5:3, 5:4, 5:9 +; כָּל־דְּנָה Dn 5:22. b. אַחֲרֵי דְנָה after this †Dn 2:29, 2:45; so בָּאתַר דְּנָה † 7:6, 7:7. c. כִּדְנָה like this, thus, † Je 10:10 (= Heb. כֹּה), Dn 2:10 מִלְּתָא כִדְנָה a word like this (cf. כָּזֹאת Est 4:14), 3:29, Ezr 5:7. d. עַל־דְּנָה on account of this †Dn 3:16, Ezr 4:22, 5:5, 5:17, 6:11; as conj. = therefore (cf. Heb. עַל־זֹאת) Ezr 4:14, 4:15.—Vid. also קֳבֵלַ and קַדְמָה. p. 1080

title: דְּקַק
content: [Str1751,1855,1854] † [דְּקַק] vb. be shattered, fall to pieces (BH);—Pe. Pf. 3 mpl. דָּקוּ Dn 2:35. Haph. break in pieces: Pf. 3 fs. הַדֶּ֫קֶת 2:34, 2:45, 3 mpl.הַדִָּקוּ 6:25 (all sq. acc.); Impf. 3 fs. תַּדִּק 2:40 (abs.), v:44 (acc.); sf. תַּדֱּקִנַּהּ 7:23; Pt. act. מְהַדֵּק 2:40 (acc.), f. מַדֱּקָה (K§ 46, 3 b)) abs. 7:7, 7:19.

title: דָּר
content:
[Str1859] דָּר v. דוּר

[Str1867–68] דָּֽרְיָ֫וֶשׁ:15 n. pr. m. (BH id.; Eg. Aram. דריוהוש RÉS361 S-CH 1+);—1. Darius Hystaspis Ezr 4:24 + 8 t. Ezr. 2. ‘Darius the Mede’ Dn 6:1, 6:2, 6:7, 6:10, 6:26, 6:29.

title: דרע
content:
[Str2220] דרע (√of following; BH II. זרע, זְרוֺעַ).

[Str1872] † [דְּרָע] n.[f.] arm (so Targum Syr.);—pl. sf. דְּרָע֫וֺהִי Dn 2:32.

[Str153,248] † אֶדְרַע (K§ 60, l)) n. [f.] force (prop. arm, Targum (rare); BH אֶזְרוֺעַ);—abs. וְחָיִל ´בְּא: Ezr 4:23 by force and power, forcibly.

[Str1882,1881] † דָּת n. f.:Dn 6:9 decree, law (Syr.; Pers. loan-word, v. BH);—´ד: abs. Dn 6:16, 7:25, cstr. Ezr 7:14 +; emph. דָּתָא Ezr 7:12 +; sf. דָּֽתְכוֺן Dn 2:9;—1. decree of king Dn 2:13, 2:15, Ezr 7:26; c. sf. Dn 2:9 decree against you. 2. unchangeable law of Medes and Pers. Dn 6:9, 6:13, 6:16. 3. law of God (in mouth of non-Jews): Dn 6:6, Ezr 7:12, 7:14, 7:21, 7:26, so (abs.) Dn 7:25; laws of God Ezr 7:25.

[Str1883,1877] † [דֶּ֫תֶא] n. [m.] grass (so Targum Syr.; BH דֶּשֶׁא);—emph. דִּתְאָא Dn 4:12, 4:20.

title: דְּתָבָר
content: [Str1884] ‡ † [דְּתָבָר] n. m. judge (loan-word fr. Pers. dâtabara, law-bearer, judge (cf. דִּינָיֵא), AndrM 59* MeyEntst. J. 23 DrDn; in Bab. as dâtabar(r)i HilprBab. Exp. ix. 28);—pl. emph. דְּתָֽבְרַיָּא Dn 3:2, 3:3.
